notes.title: Update notes for 11/12/2021
notes.notes: This build includes some minor bug fixes and adjusted the spawn timers for the levels.

notes.title: Current Status of Cyborgs Attack
notes.notes:
As the developer of Cyborgs Attack, I want to make sure the game works everywhere, for everyone and is fun to play plus has exciting content.  I am constantly reviewing the forums for suggestions and if you find any problems, please do not hesitate to let me know, I will work diligently to make sure that they are resolved as quickly as possible.  I know, as players, you are expecting that "bang for buck" and I will do my best to make sure you have the experience you are looking for.

All updates to the game including added enemies, added maps, additional content, will come with your purchase, I will not be creating separate billable DLC's for the game, at some point I might separate out maps into different DLC's, but again, those will be free to all players who purchase the game.  I do listen to my players and I take into full consideration there requests and do my best to see where and how these requests can further enhance the game for everyone.

Thank you for supporting Cyborgs Attack and I look forward to growing this game to even richer content over time. 

The latest hiccup in the game that was discovered, I have resolved, this was where the scene was blue and the game UI icons were visible, this was due to a floating point conversion in the core engine that I used to build the game on, I corrected this as quickly as i could once I was made aware of the problem. Please always take the time to let the developers of games know of any issues you have so that we have the chance to resolve them as quickly and efficiently as possible.
